Ти — HR-асистент. Відповідай на питання рекрутера чи HR-фахівця лише на основі наданих джерел.

Правила:
- Використовуй тільки інформацію з джерел. Не додавай знань ззовні.
- Після кожного твердження став номер джерела у квадратних дужках, наприклад [2].
- Якщо в джерелах немає відповіді, відповідай: «Не знаю: у документах немає відповіді на це питання.»
- Відповідай мовою питання, коротко (до 5 речень).

Джерела:

[1] Employee Handbook V2 — 1. About this handbook (версія 2025-03-01, чинна)
Effective 2025-03-01. Replaces Employee Handbook V1 of 2024-01-15.

Fictional company. Course project document, not legal advice.

## 1. About this handbook

This handbook explains the main rules of working at Polaris Demo LLC: working time, leave, remote work, equipment and conduct. Where the handbook and the Labour Code of Ukraine differ, the Labour Code applies. Questions go to the HR team at hr@polaris-demo.example.

[2] Employee Handbook V2 — 13. Contacts (версія 2025-03-01, чинна)
HR team: hr@polaris-demo.example. IT service desk: it@polaris-demo.example. Security officer: security@polaris-demo.example. Urgent questions outside working hours go to the security officer.

[3] Положення про преміювання працівників (версія 2025-02-01, чинна)
ТОВ «Поляріс Демо» — для внутрішнього користування

# Положення про преміювання працівників

Діє з 2025-02-01. Вигадана компанія. Документ навчального проєкту, не є юридичною консультацією.

[5] Law of Ukraine on Employment of the Population (unofficial ILO translation) — Article 43. Status of registered unemployed (версія draft, чинна)
__

1. The status of registered unemployed can be acquired by:

__

1) a person of working age before the appointment of a pension (in particular, by age, on preferential terms or by years of service), who, due to lack of work, does not have earnings or other income provided for by law, is ready and able to start work;

__

2) a person with a disability who has not reached the retirement age established by Article 26 of the Law of Ukraine "On Mandatory State Pension Insurance" and receives a disability pension or social assistance in accordance with the laws of Ukraine "On State Social Assistance to Persons with Disabilities from Childhood and Children with by disability" and "On state social assistance to persons who do not have the right to a pension and persons with disabilities" ;

__

3) a person younger than 16 years of age who worked and was dismissed in connection with changes in the organization of production and work, in particular, termination or repurposing of enterprises, institutions and organizations, reduction of the number (staff) of employees;

4) a single mother (father), who (who) cares for a child with a disability and one of the parents, adoptive parents, parents-educators of a family-type orphanage, an adoptive parent, guardian, custodian of a child with a disability of subgroup A, who in accordance with the Law of Ukraine "On

State Social Assistance to Persons with Disabilities from Childhood and Children with Disabilities" have the right to receive a child care allowance.

__

2. The status of registered unemployed is granted to the persons specified in the first part of this article on the day they submit a personal application for granting the status of registered unemployed to any territorial body of the central executive body of their choice, which implements state policy in the field of population employment and labor migration, regardless of from the presence or absence of such persons' declared and registered place of residence (stay).

Individual provision of services to the unemployed, who has applied for the status of registered unemployed, is carried out by a career counselor, and to the unemployed who need assistance in adapting to the conditions of the labor market, by a specialized career counselor.

[6] Law of Ukraine on Employment of the Population (unofficial ILO translation) — Article 3. The right to employment (версія draft, чинна)
1. Everyone has the right to freely chosen employment.

2. Forced labor in any form is prohibited.

Voluntary unemployment of a person cannot be the basis for bringing him to responsibility.

3. Employment of the population is ensured by establishing relations regulated by labor agreements (contracts), conducting business and other types of activities not prohibited by law.

4. Foreigners and stateless persons permanently residing in Ukraine, who have been recognized as refugees in Ukraine, who have been granted asylum in Ukraine, who have been recognized as persons in need of additional protection, who have been granted temporary protection, as well as those who have received permission to immigrate to Ukraine, have the right to employment on the grounds and in the manner established for citizens of Ukraine.

Foreigners and stateless persons who have arrived in Ukraine for employment for a specified period of time are hired by employers on the basis of a permit for the employment of foreigners and stateless persons issued in accordance with the procedure established by this Law, unless otherwise provided by laws and/or international treaties of Ukraine, whose binding consent has been given by the Verkhovna Rada of Ukraine.

__

Foreigners and stateless persons included in the list of persons connected with terrorist activities or subject to international sanctions, as well as foreigners and stateless persons subject to special economic and other restrictive measures (sanctions) in accordance with the Law of Ukraine "On Sanctions".

__

##### Article 4. Employed population

1. The employed population includes persons who work for hire under the terms of an employment contract (contract) or under other conditions provided for by law, persons who provide themselves with work independently (including members of personal peasant households), are undergoing military or alternative (non-military) ) service, who legally work abroad and who have income from such employment, as well as persons who study full-time or dual education in institutions of general secondary, professional (vocational-technical), professional pre-higher and higher education and combine studies with work

__

The employed population also includes:

[7] Law of Ukraine on Employment of the Population (unofficial ILO translation) — Article 14. Categories of citizens with additional guarantees in promoting employment (версія draft, чинна)
1. The categories of citizens who have additional guarantees in promoting employment include:

1) one of the parents or a person replacing them and:

has dependent child(ren) under the age of six;

__

raises a child under the age of 14 or a child with a disability without one of the spouses;

maintains without one of the spouses a person with a disability since childhood (regardless of age) and/or a person with a disability of the I group (regardless of the cause of disability);

2) orphans and children deprived of parental care;

__

3) persons released after serving a sentence or forced treatment;

4) young people who have completed or stopped studying in institutions of general secondary, professional (vocational-technical), professional pre-higher and higher education, have been released from fixed-term military or alternative (non-military) service, military service by conscription of reservists in a special period ( within six months after the end or termination of education or service) and who is hired for the first time;

__

5) persons who have 10 or less years left before the right to an old-age pension in accordance with Article 26 of the Law of Ukraine "On Mandatory State Pension Insurance" ;

6) persons with disabilities who have not reached the retirement age established by Article 26 of the Law of Ukraine "On Mandatory State Pension Insurance" ;

7) persons who have reached the age of 15 and who, with the consent of one of their parents or a person who replaces them, can, as an exception, be hired;

8) participants in hostilities specified in clauses 19-21 of the first part of Article 6 of the Law of Ukraine "On the status of war veterans, guarantees of their social protection;

__

9) unemployed able-bodied persons who receive state social assistance to low-income families;

__

[8] Law of Ukraine on Employment of the Population (unofficial ILO translation) — Article 3. The right to employment (версія draft, чинна)
unemployed able-bodied persons who actually care for a child with a disability, a person with a disability of group I or an elderly person who, according to the opinion of a medical institution, needs constant external care or has reached the age of 80, and receive assistance, compensation and/or allowance, respectively to legislation;

parents - educators of family-type children's homes, foster parents, foster educators, if they receive financial support in accordance with the legislation;

__

a person who lives together with a person with a disability of group I or II due to a mental disorder, who, according to the opinion of the medical commission of a medical institution, needs constant external care, and receives financial assistance for his care in accordance with the legislation;

__

a single mother (father) who (who) cares for a child with a disability, and one of the parents, adoptive parents, parents-educators of a family-type orphanage, an adoptive parent, a guardian, a custodian of a child with a disability of subgroup A, who in accordance with the Law of Ukraine " On state social assistance to persons with disabilities from childhood and children with disabilities" have the right to receive a child care allowance.

__

The persons specified in the sixth paragraph of this part have the right to receive the status of registered unemployed and at the same time receive unemployment benefits in accordance with the legislation."

__

2. The employed population does not include foreigners and stateless persons who are in Ukraine and whose employment is related to ensuring the activities of foreign embassies and missions or fulfilling their professional or labor duties to a non-resident employer.
